definitions.budget: Complete closed daily batch floor(0.1*N), no carryover. Unknown outcomes compete before masking. Subgroups are never reranked or capped.

definitions.interpretation: April and the eight masks are retrospective descriptive targets motivated by already inspected results; not a prespecified hypothesis test or model selection.
